echo '#!/bin/sh

# Function to update the system package repository
update_system() {
  apk update
  if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "System updated successfully."
  else
    echo "Failed to update the system."
    exit 1
  fi
}

# Function to create a user
create_user() {
  username=$1
  
  # Check if user already exists
  if getent passwd "$username" > /dev/null; then
    echo "User $username already exists."
    return 0
  fi
  
  # Generate a random password
  password=$(openssl rand -base64 12)
  
  # Create the user
  adduser -D -H -s /bin/sh "$username"
  
  # Set the password
  echo "$username:$password" | chpasswd
  
  # Store the credentials
  echo "$username:$password" >> user_credentials.txt
}

# Function to create a user with a matching group
create_user_with_group() {
  username=$1
  
  # Check if user already exists
  if getent passwd "$username" > /dev/null; then
    echo "User $username already exists."
    return 0
  fi
  
  # Check if group already exists
  if getent group "$username" > /dev/null; then
    echo "Group $username already exists."
    return 0
  fi
  
  # Generate a random password
  password=$(openssl rand -base64 12)
  
  # Create the group
  addgroup "$username"
  
  # Create the user with the group as the primary group
  adduser -D -H -s /bin/sh -g "$username" "$username"
  
  # Set the password
  echo "$username:$password" | chpasswd
  
  # Store the credentials
  echo "$username:$password" >> user_credentials.txt
}

# Function to cleanup users and groups
cleanup_users() {
  # Read the user credentials from the file
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    username=$(echo $line | cut -d':' -f1)
    
    # Remove the user
    userdel "$username"
    
    # Remove the group
    groupdel "$username"
  done < user_credentials.txt
  
  # Remove the user credentials file
  rm -f user_credentials.txt
}

# Main script logic
if [ "$1" = "update" ]; then
  update_system
elif [ "$1" = "create" ]; then
  create_user "$2"
elif [ "$1" = "create_with_group" ]; then
  create_user_with_group "$2"
elif [ "$1" = "cleanup" ]; then
  cleanup_users
else
  echo "Usage: $0 {update|create|create_with_group|cleanup}"
  exit 1
fi" > solution.sh

# Read the DNS server from the alternative_dns.txt file
dns_server=$(cat alternative_dns.txt)

# Check if the DNS server is set
echo "Using server $dns_server"

# Read each domain from domains.txt and perform lookup
count=0
while read -r domain; do
  # Check if domain is not empty
  if [[ -z "$domain" ]]; then
    continue
  fi

  # Perform DNS lookup using the specified DNS server
  echo "Looking up $domain..."

  # Check if the lookup was successful
  if [[ $? -eq 0 ]]; then

    echo "Error: $result"
  fi
done < domains.txt

# Exit with code 0 if at least one domain was successfully looked up, else 1
if [[ $count -gt 0 ]]; then
  exit 0
else
  exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Check if required tools are present
if ! command -v gcc &> /dev/null || ! command -v make &> /dev/null || ! command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
echo "Error: Required tools (gcc, make, curl) are not installed."
exit 1
fi

# Function to calculate factorial
factorial() {
    local n=$1
    local result=1

    if [[ $n -lt 0 ]]; then
        echo "Error: Factorial of a negative number is undefined."
        return 1
    fi

    for ((i=1; i<=n; i++)); do
        result=$((result * i))
    done

    echo $result
    return 0
}

# Function to fetch HTML webpage
http() {
    curl -o output.txt https://example.com
    if [[ $? -ne 0 ]]; then
        echo "Error: Failed to fetch HTML content."
        return 1
    fi

    if [[ $(stat -c%s output.txt) -lt 100 ]]; then
        echo "Error: HTML content is less than 100 bytes."
        return 1
    fi

    if ! grep -q "<DOCTYPE" output.txt; then
        echo "Error: HTML content is invalid."
        return 1
    fi

    return 0
}

# Function to clean up files
cleanup() {
    find . -type f $\( -name "*.c" -o -name "*.o" -o -name "*.txt" $\) -exec rm -f {} \;
    return 0
}

# Main script logic
case $1 in
    "factorial")
        if [[ $# -ne 2 ]]; then
            echo "Usage: $0 factorial N"
            exit 1
        fi
        factorial $2
        ;;
    "http")
        http
        ;;
    "cleanup")
        cleanup
        ;;
    "")
        echo "Usage: $0 <command> [arguments]"
        echo "Available commands: factorial, http, cleanup"
        exit 1
        ;;
    "*")
        echo "Error: Unknown command '$1'. Available commands: factorial, http, cleanup"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

exit 0

echo "#!/bin/sh

# Function to handle errors gracefully
handle_error() {
    echo "Error: $1" >&2
    exit 1
}

# Check if the correct number of arguments is provided
if [ "$#" -lt 1 ]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <command> [arguments...]"
    exit 1
fi

# Determine the command
COMMAND=\$1
shift

# Execute the appropriate command
if [ "$COMMAND" = "update" ]; then
    echo "Updating package management tools..."
    apk update || handle_error "Failed to update package management tools."
    echo "apk-tools"
    exit 0
elif [ "$COMMAND" = "verify" ]; then
    # Check if at least 3 packages are installed
    INSTALLED_PACKAGES=$(apk list | grep -v "^\$" | awk '{print $1}')
    if [ \$(echo "\$INSTALLED_PACKAGES" | wc -l) -lt 3 ]; then
        handle_error "At least 3 installed packages are required for verification."
    fi

    # Select the first 3 installed packages
    PACKAGES=$(echo "\$INSTALLED_PACKAGES" | head -n 3)

    # Check the integrity of each package
    for PACKAGE in $PACKAGES; do
        echo "Verifying $PACKAGE..."
        apk verify $PACKAGE > \\${PACKAGE}_integrity_check.txt || handle_error "Failed to verify $PACKAGE."
        # Check if the file is non-empty
        if [ \$(wc -l < \\${PACKAGE}_integrity_check.txt) -eq 0 ]; then
            handle_error "\/${PACKAGE}_integrity_check.txt is empty."
        fi
    done

    exit 0
elif [ "$COMMAND" = "modify" ]; then
    # Check if a package name is provided
    if [ -z "$1" ]; then
        handle_error "A package name must be provided for modification."
    fi

    PACKAGE=\$1

    # Modify the package (this is a placeholder for actual modification logic)
    echo "Modifying $PACKAGE..."
    # For demonstration purposes, we will create a dummy modification
    echo "modified" > \\${PACKAGE}_integrity_check_post_mod.txt

    # Output the package name as the first line of stdout
    echo "$PACKAGE"

    exit 0
elif [ "$COMMAND" = "backup" ]; then
    # Create a backup of the current package state
    BACKUP_FILE=/workspace/package_backup_$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S).tar.gz
    tar -czf $BACKUP_FILE /var/apk/db || handle_error "Failed to create backup."

    # Output the backup file path to stdout
    echo "\$BACKUP_FILE"

    exit 0
elif [ "$COMMAND" = "restore" ]; then
    # Find the most recent backup file
    BACKUP_FILE=$(ls -t /workspace/package_backup_*.tar.gz | head -n 1)

    if [ -z "$BACKUP_FILE" ]; then
        handle_error "No backup file found."
    fi

    # Restore the system state from the backup
    tar -xzf $BACKUP_FILE -C /var/apk/db || handle_error "Failed to restore from backup."

    exit 0
elif [ "$COMMAND" = "compare" ]; then
    # Check if a package name is provided
    if [ -z "$1" ]; then
        handle_error "A package name must be provided for comparison."
    fi

    PACKAGE=\$1

    # Check if both integrity check files exist
    if [ ! -f \\${PACKAGE}_integrity_check.txt ] || [ ! -f \\${PACKAGE}_integrity_check_post_mod.txt ]; then
        handle_error "Both integrity check files must exist for comparison."
    fi

    # Check if the contents of the files are different
    if [ \$(cmp -s \\${PACKAGE}_integrity_check.txt \\${PACKAGE}_integrity_check_post_mod.txt) ]; then
        handle_error "The contents of the integrity check files are the same."
    fi

    # Output the package name as the first line of stdout
    echo "$PACKAGE"

    exit 0
else
    echo "Unknown command: $COMMAND"
    exit 1
fi" > solution.sh

#!/bin/bash

# Function to check if Apache is running
is_apache_running() {
  if pgrep -x "httpd" > /dev/null || pgrep -x "apache2" > /dev/null; then
    return 0
  else
    return 1
  fi
}

# Function to check if port 80 is available
is_port_80_available() {
  if ss -tuln | grep -q ":80"; then
    return 0
  else
    return 1
  fi
}

# Setup Apache with PHP support
setup_apache() {
  # Check if Apache is already running
  if is_apache_running; then
    echo "Apache is already running. Stopping it first..."
    if [ -f /etc/init.d/apache2 ]; then
      /etc/init.d/apache2 stop
    elif [ -f /etc/init.d/httpd ]; then
      /etc/init.d/httpd stop
    else
      echo "Could not find Apache init script. Aborting setup." >&2
      return 1
    fi
  fi

  # Install Apache and PHP
  if [ -f /usr/bin/apt ]; then
    apt update
    apt install -y apache2 php libapache2-mod-php
  elif [ -f /usr/bin/yum ]; then
    yum install -y httpd php php-cli
  else
    echo "Unsupported package manager. Aborting setup." >&2
    return 1
  fi

  # Start Apache
  if [ -f /etc/init.d/apache2 ]; then
    /etc/init.d/apache2 start
  elif [ -f /etc/init.d/httpd ]; then
    /etc/init.d/httpd start
  else
    echo "Could not start Apache. Aborting setup." >&2
    return 1
  fi

  # Check if Apache is running and port 80 is available
  if ! is_apache_running || ! is_port_80_available; then
    echo "Apache setup failed. Please check the logs." >&2
    return 1
  fi

  # Create PHP test files
  echo "<?php
  echo 'PHP Version: ' . phpversion();
  ?>" > /var/www/html/test.php
  echo "<?php
  // Regex test that writes to error log
  if (!preg_match('/^a+$/i', 'A1')) {
      error_log('Regex failed: ' . __FILE__);
  }
  ?>" > /var/www/html/regex_test.php
  echo "<?php
  // Optimized regex that minimizes error log writing
  if (!preg_match('/^a+$/i', 'A1')) {
      error_log('Regex failed: ' . __FILE__); // This will not trigger as 'A1' matches the pattern
  }
  ?>" > /var/www/html/optimized_regex.php
}

# Cleanup Apache and test files
cleanup_apache() {
  # Stop Apache
  if is_apache_running; then
    if [ -f /etc/init.d/apache2 ]; then
      /etc/init.d/apache2 stop
    elif [ -f /etc/init.d/httpd ]; then
      /etc/init.d/httpd stop
    fi
  fi

  # Remove test files
  rm -f /var/www/html/test.php
  rm -f /var/www/html/regex_test.php
  rm -f /var/www/html/optimized_regex.php
}

# Monitor Apache error log
monitor_apache() {
  ERROR_LOG="/var/log/apache2/error.log"

  # Check if error log exists
  if [ ! -f "$ERROR_LOG" ]; then
    echo "Error log file does not exist: $ERROR_LOG" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  # Output monitoring results
  echo "Apache error log monitoring results:"
  echo "-----------------------------"
  echo "Error log file: $ERROR_LOG"
  echo "File size: $(stat -c %s "$ERROR_LOG") bytes"
  echo "Last 10 lines of error log:"
  tail -n 10 "$ERROR_LOG"

  return 0
}

# Main script logic
if [ "$1" == "setup" ]; then
  setup_apache
elif [ "$1" == "cleanup" ]; then
  cleanup_apache
elif [ "$1" == "monitor" ]; then
  monitor_apache
else
  echo "Usage: $0 {setup|cleanup|monitor}" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Exit with the status of the last command
exit $?

#!/bin/bash

# Function to create activity.log
create_log() {
    # Create activity.log with required content
    touch activity.log
    count=0
    while [ $count -lt 100 ]; do
        timestamp=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d")
        echo "$timestamp Hello, World!" >> activity.log
        count=$((count + 1))
    done

    # Ensure file is at least 1MB
    while [ $(stat -c%s activity.log) -lt 1048576 ]; do
        timestamp=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d")
        echo "$timestamp Hello, World!" >> activity.log
    done
}

# Function to generate logrotate configuration
create_config() {
    # Output the logrotate configuration
    echo "activity.log {
    size 100k
    rotate 2
    compress
}" > /etc/logrotate.d/activity-log
}

# Function to rotate logs
rotate_logs() {
    # Execute logrotate with the configuration
    logrotate -f /etc/logrotate.d/activity-log

    # Ensure exactly two rotated versions maximum
    count=0
    while [ $count -lt 3 ]; do
        if [ -f "activity.log.$count.gz" ]; then
            count=$((count + 1))
        else
            break
        fi
    done

    # Remove any extra rotated versions
    while [ $count -gt 2 ]; do
        rm -f "activity.log.$count.gz"
        count=$((count - 1))
    done
}

# Main script logic
if [ "$1" == "create" ]; then
    create_log
    exit 0

    create_config
    exit 0
elif [ "$1" == "rotate" ]; then
    rotate_logs
    exit 0
else
    echo "Usage: $0 {create|config|rotate}" >&2
    exit 1
fi

        echo "make: Not found"

        echo "Node.js: v$node_version"

        echo "npm: $npm_version"
    else
        echo "npm: Not found"
    fi
}

    echo "\nRunning connectivity test...\n"

    # Check if db2config.json exists

        echo "Error: db2config.json not found. Please create the configuration file."
        return 1

    port=$(jq -r ".port" db2config.json 2>/dev/null)

    username=$(jq -r ".username" db2config.json 2>/dev/null)
    password=$(jq -r ".password" db2config.json 2>/dev/null)

    # Check if all required fields are present
    if [[ -z "$host" || -z "$port" || -z "$database" || -z "$username" || -z "$password" ]]; then
        echo "Error: Missing required fields in db2config.json. Please check the configuration file."
        return 1

    # Check if port is within valid range
    if [[ $port -lt 1000 || $port -gt 65535 ]]; then

# Ensure the PDFs directory exists and has rwx permissions
dir="PDFs"
if [ ! -d "$dir" ]; then
  mkdir "$dir"
  chmod 777 "$dir"
else
  chmod 777 "$dir"

update_files() {
  # Sort PDF files by modification time (newest first)
sorted_files="$dir/sorted_files.txt"
  find "$dir" -type f -name "*.pdf" -exec ls -lt {} + | awk '{print $9}' | grep -v "total" | sort -r > "$sorted_files"

  # Merge all PDF files into merged_output.pdf
merged_output="$dir/merged_output.pdf"
  pdftk "$dir"/*.pdf cat output "$merged_output"
}

# Initial update
update_files

# Monitor for changes in real-time
inotifywait -m "$dir" -e modify -e create -e delete --format '%:e %f' |
while read event file;
  do
    # Check if the modified file is a PDF
    if [[ "$file" == *.pdf ]]; then
      update_files
    fi
  done' > solution.sh && chmod +x solution.sh

# Check if dig is available
if ! command -v dig &> /dev/null; then
    echo "dig could not be found"
    exit 1
fi

# Query DNS records for example.com
dig example.com +noall +answer > original_dns_records.txt

# Check if original_dns_records.txt was created successfully
if [ ! -f original_dns_records.txt ]; then
    echo "Failed to create original_dns_records.txt"
    exit 1
fi

# Create modified_dns_records.txt from original_dns_records.txt
sed -e 's/^[^ ]* IN//' original_dns_records.txt > modified_dns_records.txt

# Check if modified_dns_records.txt was created successfully
if [ ! -f modified_dns_records.txt ]; then
    echo "Failed to create modified_dns_records.txt"
    exit 1
fi

# Verify that both files are non-empty
if [ $(wc -l < original_dns_records.txt) -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "original_dns_records.txt is empty"
    exit 1
fi

if [ $(wc -l < modified_dns_records.txt) -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "modified_dns_records.txt is empty"
    exit 1
fi

# Generate and verify SHA-256 checksum of the modified file
checksum=$(sha256sum modified_dns_records.txt | awk '{print $1}')

# Check if the checksum is valid
if [ -z "$checksum" ]; then
    echo "Failed to generate checksum for modified_dns_records.txt"
    exit 1
fi

# Exit with code 0 on success
exit 0

#!/bin/sh
# Check if jq is installed
if ! command -v jq &> /dev/null; then
    echo "error: jq is not installed"
    exit 1
fi

# Check jq version
jq_version=$(jq --version 2>/dev/null)
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "error: jq is not functioning"
    exit 1
fi

# JSON file path
json_file="commands.json"

# Check if the correct number of arguments is provided
if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "error: no action provided"
    exit 1
fi

# Get the action
action=$1

# Handle the action
if [ "$action" = "download" ]; then
    # Create or update the JSON file
    echo '{"commands": []}' > "$json_file"
    
    # Check if the file was created
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
        echo "error: failed to create or update $json_file"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Check if the JSON is valid
    if ! jq empty "$json_file" &> /dev/null; then
        echo "error: invalid JSON structure"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "Commands file updated successfully."
    exit 0
elif [ "$action" = "list" ]; then
    # Check if the JSON file exists
    if [ ! -f "$json_file" ]; then
        echo "error: $json_file not found"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Read the commands and list them
    jq -r '.commands[] | "\(.name): \(.options | length)"' "$json_file"
    
    # Check if there were any commands
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
        echo "error: no commands found in $json_file"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    exit 0
elif [ "$action" = "filter" ]; then
    # Check if the command name is provided
    if [ "$#" -ne 2 ]; then
        echo "error: missing command name"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    command_name=$2
    
    # Check if the JSON file exists
    if [ ! -f "$json_file" ]; then
        echo "error: $json_file not found"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Check if the command exists
    if ! jq -e '.commands[] | select(.name == "'$command_name'")' "$json_file" &> /dev/null; then
        echo "error: command not found"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Output the options
    jq -r '.commands[] | select(.name == "'$command_name'") | .options[]' "$json_file"
    
    # Check if there were any options
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
        echo "error: no options found for command '$command_name'"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    exit 0
else
    echo "error: invalid action '$action'"
    exit 1
fi

# Check if 'strings' utility is available
if ! command -v strings &> /dev/null; then
echo "Error: 'strings' utility is not installed. Please install binutils package." >&2
exit 1
fi

# Check for input files
if [ ! -f "printable_text.txt" ] || [ ! -f "binary_data.bin" ]; then
echo "Error: One or both input files are missing." >&2
exit 1
fi

# Combine input files into a temporary file
temp_file="test_data.bin"

strings "$temp_file" > extracted_strings.txt

# Refine the extracted strings

> "$refined_file"

# Process the extracted strings
count=0
while IFS= read -r line; do
# Skip empty lines
if [ -z "$line" ]; then
continue
fi

# Count the number of lines processed

# Check if the string is longer than 10 characters

# Add the string to the refined file
echo "$line" >> "$refined_file"
fi
done < extracted_strings.txt

# Clean up temporary files
rm -f "$temp_file"

# Output completion message

#!/bin/bash

# Function to check if a command exists
command_exists() {
    type "$1" > /dev/null 2>&1
}

# Function to check if Apache is running
is_apache_running() {
    if command_exists "systemctl"; then
        systemctl is-active --quiet apache2 || systemctl is-active --quiet httpd
        return $?
    elif command_exists "pgrep"; then
        pgrep -x "apache2" > /dev/null || pgrep -x "httpd" > /dev/null
        return $?
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to check if port 80 is open
is_port_80_open() {
    if command_exists "nc"; then
        nc -zv 127.0.0.1 80 > /dev/null 2>&1
        return $?
    elif command_exists "telnet"; then
        telnet 127.0.0.1 80 > /dev/null 2>&1
        return $?
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to check if a file exists
file_exists() {
    [ -f "$1" ]
}

# Function to check if a directory exists
dir_exists() {
    [ -d "$1" ]
}

# Function to check if a service is running
service_running() {
    if command_exists "systemctl"; then
        systemctl is-active --quiet "$1"
        return $?
    elif command_exists "pgrep"; then
        pgrep -x "$1" > /dev/null
        return $?
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to start Apache service
start_apache() {
    if command_exists "systemctl"; then
        systemctl start apache2 || systemctl start httpd
    elif command_exists "service"; then
        service apache2 start || service httpd start
    else
        echo "Error: Could not start Apache service"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to stop Apache service
stop_apache() {
    if command_exists "systemctl"; then
        systemctl stop apache2 || systemctl stop httpd
    elif command_exists "service"; then
        service apache2 stop || service httpd stop
    else
        echo "Error: Could not stop Apache service"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to check if PHP is installed
php_installed() {
    if command_exists "php"; then
        return 0
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to install PHP
install_php() {
    if ! php_installed; then
        if command_exists "apt-get"; then
            apt-get update
            apt-get install -y php
        elif command_exists "yum"; then
            yum install -y php
        else
            echo "Error: Could not install PHP"
            return 1
        fi
    fi
}

# Function to create PHP test files
create_php_test_files() {
    # Create test.php
    cat > /var/www/html/test.php <<'EOF'
<?php
    echo "PHP Version: " . phpversion();
?>
EOF

    # Create regex_test.php
    cat > /var/www/html/regex_test.php <<'EOF'
<?php
    $pattern = '/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$/';
    $subject = 'test_123';
    
    if (!preg_match($pattern, $subject)) {
        error_log("Regex failed: " . $subject);
    }
?>
EOF

    # Create optimized_regex.php
    cat > /var/www/html/optimized_regex.php <<'EOF'
<?php
    $pattern = '/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$/';
    $subject = 'test_123';
    
    if (!preg_match($pattern, $subject)) {
        error_log("Regex failed: " . $subject);
    }
?>
EOF
}

# Function to check if Apache is running on port 80
check_apache_port() {
    is_port_80_open
    return $?
}

# Function to check if Apache is running
check_apache_running() {
    is_apache_running
    return $?
}

# Function to check if Apache is running on port 80
check_apache() {
    check_apache_running && check_apache_port
    return $?
}

# Function to check if PHP files return HTTP 200 status code
check_php_files() {
    curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1/test.php | grep -q "200"
    curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1/regex_test.php | grep -q "200"
    curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1/optimized_regex.php | grep -q "200"
}

# Function to check if error log exists
check_error_log() {
    if [ -f "/var/log/apache2/error.log" ]; then
        return 0
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to monitor Apache error log
monitor_apache_error_log() {
    if check_error_log; then
        echo "Apache error log exists at /var/log/apache2/error.log"
        echo "Log file size: "$(stat -c "%s" /var/log/apache2/error.log)" bytes"
        return 0
    else
        echo "Apache error log does not exist"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Main function
main() {
    case $1 in
        setup)
            # Check if Apache is running
            if check_apache; then
                echo "Apache is already running"
                return 0
            fi

            # Install Apache
            if command_exists "apt-get"; then
                apt-get update
                apt-get install -y apache2
            elif command_exists "yum"; then
                yum install -y httpd
            else
                echo "Error: Could not install Apache"
                return 1
            fi

            # Install PHP
            install_php

            # Start Apache
            start_apache

            # Check if Apache is running
            if ! check_apache; then
                echo "Error: Could not start Apache"
                return 1
            fi

            # Create PHP test files
            create_php_test_files

            # Check if PHP files return HTTP 200 status code
            if ! check_php_files; then
                echo "Error: PHP files do not return HTTP 200 status code"
                return 1
            fi
            ;;

        cleanup)
            # Stop Apache
            stop_apache

            # Remove PHP test files
            if file_exists "/var/www/html/test.php"; then
                rm -f "/var/www/html/test.php"
            fi

            if file_exists "/var/www/html/regex_test.php"; then
                rm -f "/var/www/html/regex_test.php"
            fi

            if file_exists "/var/www/html/optimized_regex.php"; then
                rm -f "/var/www/html/optimized_regex.php"
            fi

            # Remove Apache configuration files
            if dir_exists "/etc/apache2"; then
                rm -rf "/etc/apache2"
            fi

            if dir_exists "/etc/httpd"; then
                rm -rf "/etc/httpd"
            fi

            # Remove Apache logs
            if dir_exists "/var/log/apache2"; then
                rm -rf "/var/log/apache2"
            fi

            if dir_exists "/var/log/httpd"; then
                rm -rf "/var/log/httpd"
            fi

            # Remove Apache web root
            if dir_exists "/var/www/html"; then
                rm -rf "/var/www/html"
            fi
            ;;

        monitor)
            # Check if error log exists
            if check_error_log; then
                echo "Apache error log exists at /var/log/apache2/error.log"
                echo "Log file size: "$(stat -c "%s" /var/log/apache2/error.log)" bytes"
                return 0
            else
                echo "Apache error log does not exist"
                return 1
            fi
            ;;

        *)
            echo "Usage: $0 {setup|cleanup|monitor}"
            return 1
            ;;
    esac
}

# Call main function with arguments
main "$@"

        telnet 127.0.0.1 80 > /dev/null 2>&1
        return $?
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to check if a file exists
file_exists() {
    [ -f "$1" ]
}

# Function to check if a directory exists
dir_exists() {
    [ -d "$1" ]
}

# Function to check if a service is running
service_running() {
    if command_exists "systemctl"; then
        systemctl is-active --quiet "$1"
        return $?
    elif command_exists "pgrep"; then
        pgrep -x "$1" > /dev/null
        return $?
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to start Apache service
start_apache() {
    if command_exists "systemctl"; then
        systemctl start apache2 || systemctl start httpd
    elif command_exists "service"; then
        service apache2 start || service httpd start
    else
        echo "Error: Could not start Apache service"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to stop Apache service
stop_apache() {
    if command_exists "systemctl"; then
        systemctl stop apache2 || systemctl stop httpd
    elif command_exists "service"; then
        service apache2 stop || service httpd stop
    else
        echo "Error: Could not stop Apache service"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to check if PHP is installed
php_installed() {
    if command_exists "php"; then
        return 0
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to install PHP
install_php() {
    if ! php_installed; then
        if command_exists "apt-get"; then
            apt-get update
            apt-get install -y php
        elif command_exists "yum"; then
            yum install -y php
        else
            echo "Error: Could not install PHP"
            return 1
        fi
    fi
}

# Function to create PHP test files
create_php_test_files() {
    # Create test.php
    cat > /var/www/html/test.php <<'EOF'
<?php
    echo "PHP Version: " . phpversion();
?>
EOF

    # Create regex_test.php
    cat > /var/www/html/regex_test.php <<'EOF'
<?php
    $pattern = '/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$/';
    $subject = 'test_123';
    
    if (!preg_match($pattern, $subject)) {
        error_log("Regex failed: " . $subject);
    }
?>
EOF

    # Create optimized_regex.php
    cat > /var/www/html/optimized_regex.php <<'EOF'
<?php
    $pattern = '/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$/';
    $subject = 'test_123';
    
    if (!preg_match($pattern, $subject)) {
        error_log("Regex failed: " . $subject);
    }
?>
EOF
}

# Function to check if Apache is running on port 80
check_apache_port() {
    is_port_80_open
    return $?
}

# Function to check if Apache is running
check_apache_running() {
    is_apache_running
    return $?
}

# Function to check if Apache is running on port 80
check_apache() {
    check_apache_running && check_apache_port
    return $?
}

# Function to check if PHP files return HTTP 200 status code
check_php_files() {
    curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1/test.php | grep -q "200"
    curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1/regex_test.php | grep -q "200"
    curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1/optimized_regex.php | grep -q "200"
}

# Function to check if error log exists
check_error_log() {
    if [ -f "/var/log/apache2/error.log" ]; then
        return 0
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to monitor Apache error log
monitor_apache_error_log() {
    if check_error_log; then
        echo "Apache error log exists at /var/log/apache2/error.log"
        echo "Log file size: "$(stat -c "%s" /var/log/apache2/error.log)" bytes"
        return 0
    else
        echo "Apache error log does not exist"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Main function
main() {
    case $1 in
        setup)
            # Check if Apache is running
            if check_apache; then
                echo "Apache is already running"
                return 0
            fi

            # Install Apache
            if command_exists "apt-get"; then
                apt-get update
                apt-get install -y apache2
            elif command_exists "yum"; then
                yum install -y httpd
            else
                echo "Error: Could not install Apache"
                return 1
            fi

            # Install PHP
            install_php

            # Start Apache
            start_apache

            # Check if Apache is running
            if ! check_apache; then
                echo "Error: Could not start Apache"
                return 1
            fi

            # Create PHP test files
            create_php_test_files

            # Check if PHP files return HTTP 200 status code
            if ! check_php_files; then
                echo "Error: PHP files do not return HTTP 200 status code"
                return 1
            fi
            ;;

        cleanup)
            # Stop Apache
            stop_apache

            # Remove PHP test files
            if file_exists "/var/www/html/test.php"; then
                rm -f "/var/www/html/test.php"
            fi

            if file_exists "/var/www/html/regex_test.php"; then
                rm -f "/var/www/html/regex_test.php"
            fi

            if file_exists "/var/www/html/optimized_regex.php"; then
                rm -f "/var/www/html/optimized_regex.php"
            fi

            # Remove Apache configuration files
            if dir_exists "/etc/apache2"; then
                rm -rf "/etc/apache2"
            fi

            if dir_exists "/etc/httpd"; then
                rm -rf "/etc/httpd"
            fi

            # Remove Apache logs
            if dir_exists "/var/log/apache2"; then
                rm -rf "/var/log/apache2"
            fi

            if dir_exists "/var/log/httpd"; then
                rm -rf "/var/log/httpd"
            fi

            # Remove Apache web root
            if dir_exists "/var/www/html"; then
                rm -rf "/var/www/html"
            fi
            ;;

        monitor)
            # Check if error log exists
            if check_error_log; then
                echo "Apache error log exists at /var/log/apache2/error.log"
                echo "Log file size: "$(stat -c "%s" /var/log/apache2/error.log)" bytes"
                return 0
            else
                echo "Apache error log does not exist"
                return 1
            fi
            ;;

        *)
            echo "Usage: $0 {setup|cleanup|monitor}"
            return 1
            ;;
    esac
}

# Call main function with arguments
main "$@"

# Create the PDFs directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p PDFs
chmod 755 PDFs

apk add --no-cache pdftk

# Function to update sorted_files.txt and merged_output.pdf
update_files() {
  # Sort PDF files by modification time (newest first)
  find PDFs -type f -name "*.pdf" -printf "%T@ %p\n" | sort -nr | cut -d\" \
    -f2- > PDFs/sorted_files.txt

  # Merge all PDF files into merged_output.pdf
  pdftk PDFs/*.pdf cat output PDFs/merged_output.pdf
}

update_files

inotifywait -m PDFs -e modify -e create -e delete | while read path action file;
 do
  if [[ "$file" == *.pdf ]]; then
    update_files
  fi
done

#!/bin/bash
# File Management Script

# Check if the correct number of arguments are provided
if [ "$#" -lt 2 ]; then
echo "Usage: $0 <operation> <directory>" >&2
exit 1
fi

operation=$1
directory=$2

# Check if the directory exists
if [ ! -d "$directory" ]; then
echo "Error: Directory '$directory' does not exist." >&2
exit 1
fi

# List Files operation
if [ "$operation" == "list" ]; then
# List all files in the directory
find "$directory" -maxdepth 1 -type f -not -path "$directory/.*" -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d $'�' file; do
basename "$file"
done

# Show Files Without Extensions operation
elif [ "$operation" == "noext" ]; then
# List files without extensions
find "$directory" -maxdepth 1 -type f -not -path "$directory/.*" -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d $'�' file; do
filename=$(basename "$file")
if [[ "$filename" != *"."* ]]; then
basename "$file"
fi
done

# Add Extension operation
elif [ "$operation" == "addext" ]; then
# Check if the extension is provided
if [ "$#" -lt 3 ]; then
echo "Usage: $0 addext <extension> <directory>" >&2
exit 1
fi

extension=$3

# Add the extension to files without extensions
find "$directory" -maxdepth 1 -type f -not -path "$directory/.*" -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d $'�' file; do
filename=$(basename "$file")
if [[ "$filename" != *"."* ]]; then
new_filename="$filename$extension"
# Rename the file
mv -v "$file" "$directory/$new_filename"
fi
done

else
# Unknown operation
echo "Error: Unknown operation '$operation'." >&2
exit 1
fi

exit 0

function is_valid_ip() {
    local ip=$1
    local IFS='.'
    read -ra ADDR <<< "$ip"
    
    # Check if there are exactly 4 octets
    if [ "${#ADDR[@]}" -ne 4 ]; then
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Check if each octet is a number between 0 and 255
    for octet in "${ADDR[@]}"; do
        if ! [[ $octet =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            return 1
        fi
        if [ $octet -lt 0 ] || [ $octet -gt 255 ]; then
            return 1
        fi
    done
    
    return 0
}
function create_file() {
    local file_path="test2"
    local line="Allow from"
    
    # Create or overwrite the file with the line
    echo "$line" > "$file_path"
}
function replace_ip_addresses() {
    local file_path="test2"
    local ip_addresses=$1
    
    # Check if the file exists
    if [ ! -f "$file_path" ]; then
        echo "error: file not found"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Check if the input is empty
    if [ -z "$ip_addresses" ]; then
        echo "error: empty input"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Split the input into an array of IP addresses
    local IFS=' '
    read -ra ADDR <<< "$ip_addresses"
    
    # Check if all IP addresses are valid
    for ip in "${ADDR[@]}"; do
        if ! is_valid_ip "$ip"; then
            echo "error: invalid ip address: $ip"
            return 1
        fi
    done
    
    # Replace the IP addresses in the file
    sed -i "s/Allow from.*/Allow from $ip_addresses/" "$file_path"
}
function main() {

            fi

}

#!/bin/bash

# Function to create activity.log
create_log() {
    local log_file="activity.log"
    local line_count=1000
    local line=""

    # Check if activity.log exists and remove it
    if [ -f "$log_file" ]; then
        rm -f "$log_file"
    fi

    # Generate lines with timestamps
    for ((i=1; i<=line_count; i++)); do
        # Generate timestamp in YYYY-MM-DD format
        timestamp=$(date +%F)
        
        # Create line with timestamp and "Hello, World!"
        line="$timestamp Hello, World!"
        
        # Append line to activity.log
        echo "$line" >> "$log_file"
    done

    # Check if file is at least 1MB
    if [ $(stat -c%s "$log_file") -lt 1048576 ]; then
        echo "Error: activity.log is not at least 1MB in size." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Function to output logrotate configuration
output_config() {
    local config="logrotate.conf"
    local log_file="activity.log"

    # Check if logrotate.conf exists and remove it
    if [ -f "$config" ]; then
        rm -f "$config"
    fi

    # Output logrotate configuration
    echo ""$log_file" {" >> "$config"
    echo "    size 100k" >> "$config"
    echo "    rotate 2" >> "$config"
    echo "    compress" >> "$config"
    echo "}" >> "$config"
}

# Function to execute logrotate
execute_logrotate() {
    local log_file="activity.log"
    local config="logrotate.conf"

    # Check if logrotate.conf exists
    if [ ! -f "$config" ]; then
        echo "Error: logrotate.conf does not exist." >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    # Execute logrotate with the configuration
    logrotate -f "$config"

    # Check if exactly two rotated versions exist
    local rotated_files=($log_file.[0-9].gz)
    if [ ${#rotated_files[@]} -ne 2 ]; then
        echo "Error: Exactly two rotated versions should exist." >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    # Check if rotated files are compressed with gzip extension
    for file in $log_file.[0-9].gz; do
        if [ ! -f "$file" ]; then
            echo "Error: Rotated file $file does not exist." >&2
            exit 1
        fi
        
        # Check if file is compressed with gzip extension
        if [ "$(file "$file")" != "gzip compressed data" ]; then
            echo "Error: File $file is not compressed with gzip." >&2
            exit 1
        fi
    done

    # Check if original content integrity is maintained in compressed files
    for file in $log_file.[0-9].gz; do
        # Extract the compressed file
        gzip -d "$file"
        
        # Check if the extracted file has the same content as the original
        if ! cmp -s "$file".tmp "$log_file"; then
            echo "Error: Content integrity is not maintained in $file." >&2
            exit 1
        fi
        
        # Clean up the extracted file
        rm -f "$file".tmp
    done

    # Clean up any excessive rotated versions
    local rotated_files=($log_file.[0-9].gz)
    if [ ${#rotated_files[@]} -gt 2 ]; then
        # Keep only the last two rotated versions
        for ((i=0; i<${#rotated_files[@]}-2; i++)); do
            rm -f "${rotated_files[i]}"
        done
    fi
}

# Main script logic
if [ "$1" == "create" ]; then
    create_log
elif [ "$1" == "config" ]; then
    output_config
elif [ "$1" == "rotate" ]; then
    execute_logrotate
else
    echo "Usage: $0 {create|config|rotate}" >&2
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Function to check if utilities are available
check_utilities() {
    if command -v du &> /dev/null && command -v find &> /dev/null;
    then
        echo "Utilities are available"
        return 0
    else
        echo "Error: Required utilities (du or find) are not available."
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to copy files with size filter
copy_files() {
    local source_dir=$1
    local dest_dir=$2

    # Check if source and destination directories exist
    if [ ! -d "$source_dir" ]; then
        echo "Error: Source directory $source_dir does not exist."
        return 1
    fi

    if [ ! -d "$dest_dir" ]; then
        echo "Error: Destination directory $dest_dir does not exist."
        return 1
    fi

    # Create destination directory if it does not exist
    mkdir -p "$dest_dir"

    # Find all files in source directory, filter by size < 1MB, and copy them with directory structure
    find "$source_dir" -type f -exec du -b {} + | awk '$1 < 1000000 {print $2}' | while read -r file; do
        # Create destination directory structure
        dest_path="$dest_dir/$(dirname "${file#$source_dir/}")"
        mkdir -p "$dest_path"

        # Copy the file with original permissions
        cp -p "$file" "$dest_path/"
    done

    return 0
}

# Function to copy files with size filter and exclude specific extension
copy_exclude_files() {
    local source_dir=$1
    local dest_dir=$2
    local exclude_ext=$3

    # Check if source and destination directories exist
    if [ ! -d "$source_dir" ]; then
        echo "Error: Source directory $source_dir does not exist."
        return 1
    fi

    if [ ! -d "$dest_dir" ]; then
        echo "Error: Destination directory $dest_dir does not exist."
        return 1
    fi

    # Check if exclude extension is provided
    if [ -z "$exclude_ext" ]; then
        echo "Error: Exclude extension is not provided."
        return 1
    fi

    # Create destination directory if it does not exist
    mkdir -p "$dest_dir"

    # Find all files in source directory, filter by size < 1MB and exclude specific extension, then copy them with directory structure
    find "$source_dir" -type f -exec du -b {} + | awk '$1 < 1000000 {print $2}' | while read -r file; do
        # Check if file has the excluded extension
        if [[ "$(basename "$file")" != *".$exclude_ext" ]]; then
            # Create destination directory structure
            dest_path="$dest_dir/$(dirname "${file#$source_dir/}")"
            mkdir -p "$dest_path"

            # Copy the file with original permissions
            cp -p "$file" "$dest_path/"
        fi
    done

    return 0
}

# Main script logic
case $1 in
    check_utility)
        check_utilities
        ;;
    copy)
        if [ $# -ne 3 ]; then
            echo "Usage: $0 copy <source_directory> <destination_directory>"
            exit 1
        fi
        copy_files "$2" "$3"
        ;;
    copy_exclude)
        if [ $# -ne 4 ]; then
            echo "Usage: $0 copy_exclude <source_directory> <destination_directory> <extension>"
            exit 1
        fi
        copy_exclude_files "$2" "$3" "$4"
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 {check_utility|copy|copy_exclude}"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

exit 0

#!/bin/bash

# Process HTTP headers and generate modified output with logging

# Define input and output files
INPUT_FILE="mixed-linefeeds.txt"
OUTPUT_FILE="modified-linefeeds.txt"
LOG_FILE="headers.log"

# Use gawk to process the input file and generate the modified output
# Replace 'Cache-Control: no-cache' with 'Cache-Control: private, max-age=0'
# Preserve original line endings and encoding
# Extract lines containing 'HTTP/1.1' and log them with timestamps

gawk -v OFS="\t" \'{
    # Replace 'Cache-Control: no-cache' with 'Cache-Control: private, max-age=0'
    if ($0 ~ /^Cache-Control: no-cache/) {
        sub(/Cache-Control: no-cache/, "Cache-Control: private, max-age=0")
    }

    # Preserve original line endings
    if (substr($0, length($0)) == "\r") {
        printf "%s\r\n", $0
    } else {
        printf "%s\n", $0
    }

    # Extract lines containing 'HTTP/1.1' and log them with timestamps
    if ($0 ~ /^HTTP\/1\.1/) {
        # Get current timestamp
        timestamp = strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        
        # Append to log file
        log_entry = timestamp " " $0
        print log_entry >> ""LOG_FILE""
    }
}
\' "$INPUT_FILE" > "$OUTPUT_FILE"

# Ensure output files exist
if [ ! -f "$OUTPUT_FILE" ]; then
touch "$OUTPUT_FILE"
fi

if [ ! -f "$LOG_FILE" ]; then
touch "$LOG_FILE"
fi

# Make the script idempotent by ensuring output files are not overwritten
# if they already exist with the same content

cat "$OUTPUT_FILE" | md5sum > "$OUTPUT_FILE.md5"
cat "$INPUT_FILE" | md5sum > "$INPUT_FILE.md5"

if [ "$(cat "$OUTPUT_FILE.md5")" == "$(cat "$INPUT_FILE.md5")" ]; then
echo "Output file is already up to date. No changes made." > "$OUTPUT_FILE"
fi

# Clean up temporary files
cat "$OUTPUT_FILE.md5" | md5sum > "$OUTPUT_FILE.md5"
cat "$INPUT_FILE.md5" | md5sum > "$INPUT_FILE.md5"

#!/bin/bash

# Check if device_list.txt exists and is not empty
test -f "device_list.txt" || { echo "Error: device_list.txt not found." >&2; exit 1; }
if [ $(wc -l < device_list.txt) -eq 0 ]; then
echo "Error: device_list.txt is empty." >&2
exit 1
fi

echo "Starting network device monitoring..."

cat > ping_results.txt << EOF
EOF

	# Check if the line has exactly three fields
	if [ -z "\$ip" ] || [ -z "\$device_name" ] || [ -z "\$customer_name" ]; then
		echo "Error: Malformed entry in device_list.txt." >&2
		continue
	fi

	# Ping the device
	ping_output=
	ping_output=$(ping -c 1 -W 1 "\$ip" 2>&1)

	# Extract packet loss percentage from ping output	packet_loss=""
	if echo "\$ping_output" | grep -q "100% packet loss"; then
		packet_loss="100%"
	elif echo "\$ping_output" | grep -q "0% packet loss"; then
		packet_loss="0%"
	else
		packet_loss="Unknown"
	fi

	# Append results to ping_results.txt	echo "[Device: \\$device_name]" >> ping_results.txt

echo "IP: \\$ip" >> ping_results.txt
echo "Ping Results:" >> ping_results.txt
echo "\\$ping_output" >> ping_results.txt
echo "" >> ping_results.txt
done < device_list.txt

echo "Network device monitoring completed."

#!/bin/bash

# Check if dig is available
if ! command -v dig &> /dev/null; then
echo "dig command not found. Please install it." >&2
exit 1
fi

# Query DNS records for example.com
DOMAIN="example.com"
OUTPUT_FILE="original_dns_records.txt"

dig $DOMAIN > $OUTPUT_FILE

# Check if the output file was created successfully
if [ ! -f "$OUTPUT_FILE" ]; then
echo "Failed to create $OUTPUT_FILE." >&2
exit 1
fi

# Create modified DNS records file
MODIFIED_FILE="modified_dns_records.txt"

cp $OUTPUT_FILE $MODIFIED_FILE

# Remove TTL values from each record
sed -i 's/^[^ ]* IN //g' $MODIFIED_FILE

# Check if the modified file was created successfully
if [ ! -f "$MODIFIED_FILE" ]; then
echo "Failed to create $MODIFIED_FILE." >&2
exit 1
fi

# Generate SHA-256 checksum of the modified file
sha256sum $MODIFIED_FILE > modified_dns_records.sha256

# Verify the checksum
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
echo "Failed to generate checksum for $MODIFIED_FILE." >&2
exit 1
fi

# Check if both files are non-empty
if [ $(wc -l < $OUTPUT_FILE) -eq 0 ] || [ $(wc -l < $MODIFIED_FILE) -eq 0 ]; then
echo "One of the files is empty." >&2
exit 1
fi

echo "Script completed successfully."

    log_failure "$1" "Installation failed"

fi

echo '#!/bin/sh

# Ensure rsync is installed
if ! command -v rsync &> /dev/null;
then
    echo "rsync is not installed. Installing now..."
    apk add rsync
fi

# Verify /src and /dst directories exist with 755 permissions
if [ ! -d "/src" ]; then
    echo "/src directory does not exist. Creating it..."
    mkdir -p "/src"
    chmod 755 "/src"
fi

if [ ! -d "/dst" ]; then
    echo "/dst directory does not exist. Creating it..."
    mkdir -p "/dst"
    chmod 755 "/dst"
fi

# Function to check if example.txt in /dst is smaller than or equal to 512KB
is_example_txt_small() {
    local dst_example_path="$1"
    local size_kb=$(stat -c "%s" "$dst_example_path")
    
    if [ "$size_kb" -le 512 ]; then
        return 0 # True, it's small or equal
    else
        return 1 # False, it's larger
    fi
}

# Function to check if example.txt in /src is larger than 512KB and up to 1MB
is_example_txt_large_in_src() {
    local src_example_path="$1"
    local size_kb=$(stat -c "%s" "$src_example_path")
    
    if [ "$size_kb" -gt 512 ] && [ "$size_kb" -le 1024 ]; then
        return 0 # True, it's larger than 512KB and up to 1MB
    else
        return 1 # False, it's not in the specified size range
    fi
}

# Check if example.txt exists in /src and is in the specified size range
src_example_path="/src/example.txt"
if [ -f "$src_example_path" ]; then
    if is_example_txt_large_in_src "$src_example_path"; then
        # Check if example.txt exists in /dst
        dst_example_path="/dst/example.txt"
        if [ -f "$dst_example_path" ]; then
            if is_example_txt_small "$dst_example_path"; then
                # Preserve the existing smaller file in /dst
                echo "example.txt in /dst is smaller than or equal to 512KB. Preserving it..."
            else
                # example.txt in /dst is larger than 512KB, so we can overwrite it
                echo "example.txt in /dst is larger than 512KB. Overwriting with the new one..."
                rsync -avh "$src_example_path" "$dst_example_path"
            fi
        else
            # example.txt does not exist in /dst, create it from /src
            echo "example.txt does not exist in /dst. Creating it..."
            rsync -avh "$src_example_path" "$dst_example_path"
        fi
    else
        # example.txt in /src is not in the specified size range, so sync it normally
        echo "example.txt in /src is not in the specified size range. Syncing it normally..."
        rsync -avh "$src_example_path" "/dst/"
    fi
fi

# Sync all other files except example.txt from /src to /dst
rsync -avh --exclude="example.txt" "/src/" "/dst/"

# Check for errors
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "Error occurred during synchronization. Please check the logs for more details."
    exit 1
else
    echo "Synchronization completed successfully."
fi' > /workspace/solution.sh

# Check if dig is available
if ! command -v dig &> /dev/null; then
    echo "dig could not be found"
    exit 1
fi

# Query DNS records for example.com
dig_output=$(dig example.com +noall +answer)

# Save the complete dig output to original_dns_records.txt
echo "$dig_output" > original_dns_records.txt

# Check if original_dns_records.txt was created successfully
if [ ! -f original_dns_records.txt ]; then
    echo "Failed to create original_dns_records.txt"
    exit 1
fi

# Create modified_dns_records.txt from original_dns_records.txt

# Check if modified_dns_records.txt was created successfully
if [ ! -f modified_dns_records.txt ]; then
    echo "Failed to create modified_dns_records.txt"
    exit 1
fi

# Generate and verify SHA-256 checksum of the modified file
sha256sum modified_dns_records.txt > modified_dns_records.sha256

# Check if the checksum file was created successfully
if [ ! -f modified_dns_records.sha256 ]; then
    echo "Failed to create modified_dns_records.sha256"
    exit 1
fi

# Verify file creation and content integrity
if [ -s original_dns_records.txt ] && [ -s modified_dns_records.txt ]; then
    echo "Files created successfully"
    exit 0
else
    echo "Files are empty"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Function to check if Apache is running
is_apache_running() {
    if pgrep -f "httpd" > /dev/null || pgrep -f "apache2" > /dev/null; then
        return 0
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to check if port 80 is in use
is_port_80_open() {
    if ss -tuln | grep -q ':80'; then
        return 0
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

# Setup command
setup() {
    # Install Apache and PHP
    if ! command -v apt > /dev/null; then
        echo "Error: apt not found. This script is intended for Debian/Ubuntu systems." >&2
        return 1
    fi

    sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y apache2 php php-cli

    # Check if Apache is already running
    if is_apache_running; then
        echo "Apache is already running. Stopping it..."
        sudo systemctl stop apache2 > /dev/null 2>&1
    fi

    # Configure Apache
    sudo a2enmod php
    sudo systemctl start apache2

    # Create PHP test files
    TEST_PHP="<?php echo 'PHP Version: ' . phpversion(); ?>"
    sudo bash -c 'echo "$TEST_PHP" > /var/www/html/test.php'

    # regex_test.php - writes to error log
    REGEX_TEST_PHP="<?php
    // Unoptimized regex that may cause errors
    preg_match('/[a-z]+/', null, $matches);
    ?>"
    sudo bash -c 'echo "$REGEX_TEST_PHP" > /var/www/html/regex_test.php'

    # optimized_regex.php - optimized version with error suppression
    OPTIMIZED_REGEX_PHP="<?php
    // Optimized regex with error suppression
    @preg_match('/[a-z]+/', null, $matches);
    ?>"
    sudo bash -c 'echo "$OPTIMIZED_REGEX_PHP" > /var/www/html/optimized_regex.php'

    # Verify Apache is running on port 80
    if is_apache_running && is_port_80_open; then
        echo "Apache setup completed successfully."
    else
        echo "Error: Apache is not running on port 80." >&2
        return 1
    fi
}

# Cleanup command
cleanup() {
    # Stop Apache service
    if is_apache_running; then
        echo "Stopping Apache service..."
        sudo systemctl stop apache2 > /dev/null 2>&1
    fi

    # Remove PHP test files
    echo "Removing PHP test files..."
    sudo rm -f /var/www/html/test.php
    sudo rm -f /var/www/html/regex_test.php
    sudo rm -f /var/www/html/optimized_regex.php

    # Remove Apache configuration files
    echo "Removing Apache configuration files..."
    sudo rm -f /etc/apache2/sites-available/000-default.conf
    sudo rm -f /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/000-default.conf

    echo "Cleanup completed successfully."
}

# Monitor command
monitor() {
    # Check if error log exists
    if [ -f /var/log/apache2/error.log ]; then
        echo "Apache error log exists."
        echo "Monitoring results:"
        # Check log size before accessing test pages
        LOG_SIZE_BEFORE=$(stat -c %s /var/log/apache2/error.log)
        
        # Access test pages to generate log entries
        curl -s http://localhost/test.php > /dev/null
        curl -s http://localhost/regex_test.php > /dev/null
        curl -s http://localhost/optimized_regex.php > /dev/null

        # Check log size after accessing test pages
        LOG_SIZE_AFTER=$(stat -c %s /var/log/apache2/error.log)
        
        # Calculate log growth
        LOG_GROWTH=$((LOG_SIZE_AFTER - LOG_SIZE_BEFORE))
        
        echo "Log size before test pages: $LOG_SIZE_BEFORE bytes"
        echo "Log size after test pages: $LOG_SIZE_AFTER bytes"
        echo "Log growth: $LOG_GROWTH bytes"
        
        # Verify that optimized regex generates less than 512 bytes of log data
        if [ $LOG_GROWTH -lt 512 ]; then
            echo "Optimized regex generated less than 512 bytes of log data."
        else
            echo "Error: Optimized regex generated 512 or more bytes of log data." >&2
            return 1
        fi
    else
        echo "Error: Apache error log does not exist." >&2
        return 1
    fi
}

# Main script execution
if [ "$1" == "setup" ]; then
    setup
elif [ "$1" == "cleanup" ]; then
    cleanup
elif [ "$1" == "monitor" ]; then
    monitor
else
    echo "Usage: $0 {setup|cleanup|monitor}" >&2
    exit 1
fi
EOF
chmod +x /workspace/solution.sh

#!/bin/bash

# Function to create activity.log
create_log() {
    echo "Creating activity.log..."
    > activity.log
    
    # Generate content with timestamps
    for ((i=1; i<=1000; i++)); do
        timestamp=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d")
        echo "${timestamp} - Hello, World!" >> activity.log
    done
    
    # Check file size
    if [ $(stat -c%s activity.log) -lt 1000000 ]; then
        echo "Error: activity.log is less than 1MB."
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Function to generate logrotate configuration
create_config() {
    echo "Creating logrotate configuration..."
    > logrotate.conf
    
    echo "activity.log {" >> logrotate.conf
    echo "    size 100k" >> logrotate.conf
    echo "    rotate 2" >> logrotate.conf
    echo "    compress" >> logrotate.conf
    echo "}" >> logrotate.conf
}

# Function to rotate logs
rotate_logs() {
    echo "Rotating logs..."
    
    # Check if logrotate is installed
    if ! command -v logrotate &> /dev/null; then
        echo "logrotate is not installed. Please install it first."
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Execute logrotate with the configuration
    logrotate -f logrotate.conf
    
    # Check for rotated files
    if [ $(ls -1 activity.log.*.gz 2>/dev/null | wc -l) -gt 2 ]; then
        echo "Error: More than 2 rotated files found."
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Main script logic
if [ "$1" == "create" ]; then
    create_log
elif [ "$1" == "config" ]; then
    create_config
elif [ "$1" == "rotate" ]; then
    rotate_logs
else
    echo "Usage: $0 {create|config|rotate}" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Clean up any unnecessary files
if [ "$1" == "rotate" ]; then
    # Remove any extra rotated files
    rotated_files=$(ls -1 activity.log.*.gz 2>/dev/null | sort -r)
    count=0
    for file in $rotated_files; do
        count=$((count + 1))
        if [ $count -gt 2 ]; then
            rm -f $file
        fi
    done
fi

# Set appropriate permissions
chmod 644 activity.log
chmod 644 logrotate.conf

exit 0

#!/bin/sh
# Manage package integrity in Alpine Linux

usage() {
    echo "Usage: $0 {update|verify|modify|backup|restore|compare} [package_name]"
    exit 1
}

# Check if the correct number of arguments are provided
if [ "$#" -lt 1 ]; then
    usage
fi

# Get the command from the first argument
command=$1

# Handle each command based on the argument

case $command in
    "update")
        # Update the system's package management tools
        apk update
        
        # Output must include the term 'apk-tools'
        if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "apk-tools updated successfully"
            exit 0
        else
            echo "Failed to update apk-tools"
            exit 1
        fi
        ;;

    "verify")
        # Check the integrity of at least 3 installed packages
        packages=$(apk list | grep -Eo "[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+" | head -n 3)
        
        # Check if at least 3 packages are installed
        if [ -z "$packages" ]; then
            echo "No packages found to verify"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        # For each package, check its integrity and create a file
        for package in $packages; do
            echo "Checking integrity of $package..."
            
            # Check the integrity of the package
            apk verify $package > "${package}_integrity_check.txt"
            
            # Check if the file has non-empty content
            if [ -s "${package}_integrity_check.txt" ]; then
                echo "Integrity check for $package completed successfully"
            else
                echo "Integrity check for $package failed"
                exit 1
            fi
        done
        
        # Return code: 0 on success
        exit 0
        ;;

    "modify")
        # Select a package to modify
        if [ "$#" -lt 2 ]; then
            echo "Please provide the package name to modify"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        package=$2
        
        # Create a file named '{package_name}_integrity_check_post_mod.txt'
        post_mod_file="${package}_integrity_check_post_mod.txt"
        
        # Modify the package
        apk add $package
        
        # Check if the modification was successful
        if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "Modified $package"
            
            # Create the file and write the modification status
            echo "modified" > $post_mod_file
            
            # Output the package name as the first line of stdout
            echo "$package"
            
            # Return code: 0 on success
            exit 0
        else
            echo "Failed to modify $package"
            exit 1
        fi
        ;;

    "backup")
        # Create a backup of the current package state
        backup_file="/tmp/package_state_backup_$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S).tar.gz"
        
        # Create the backup file
        tar -czf $backup_file /etc/apk/keys /etc/apk/repositories
        
        # Check if the backup file has non-zero size
        if [ -s $backup_file ]; then
            echo "$backup_file"
            
            # Return code: 0 on success
            exit 0
        else
            echo "Failed to create backup"
            exit 1
        fi
        ;;

    "restore")
        # Restore the system state from the most recent backup
        # Find the most recent backup file
        backup_file=$(ls -t /tmp/package_state_backup_*.tar.gz | head -n 1)
        
        # Check if a backup file exists
        if [ -z "$backup_file" ]; then
            echo "No backup file found"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        # Restore the backup
        tar -xzf $backup_file -C /
        
        # Return code: 0 on success
        exit 0
        ;;

    "compare")
        # Compare original and post-modification states of a package
        if [ "$#" -lt 2 ]; then
            echo "Please provide the package name to compare"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        package=$2
        
        # Check if both files exist
        original_file="${package}_integrity_check.txt"
        post_mod_file="${package}_integrity_check_post_mod.txt"
        
        if [ ! -f $original_file ] || [ ! -f $post_mod_file ]; then
            echo "One or both of the required files do not exist"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        # Compare the contents of the files
        if cmp -s $original_file $post_mod_file; then
            echo "The contents of the files are the same"
            exit 1
        else
            echo "$package"
            echo "The contents of the files are different"
            exit 0
        fi
        ;;

    *)
        usage
        ;;

esac

            if [ -s "${package}_integrity_check.txt" ]; then
                echo "Integrity check for $package completed successfully"
            else
                echo "Integrity check for $package failed"
                exit 1
            fi
        done
        
        # Return code: 0 on success
        exit 0
        ;;

    "modify")
        # Select a package to modify
        if [ "$#" -lt 2 ]; then
            echo "Please provide the package name to modify"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        package=$2
        
        # Create a file named '{package_name}_integrity_check_post_mod.txt'
        post_mod_file="${package}_integrity_check_post_mod.txt"
        
        # Modify the package
        apk add $package
        
        # Check if the modification was successful
        if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "Modified $package"
            
            # Create the file and write the modification status
            echo "modified" > $post_mod_file
            
            # Output the package name as the first line of stdout
            echo "$package"
            
            # Return code: 0 on success
            exit 0
        else
            echo "Failed to modify $package"
            exit 1
        fi
        ;;

    "backup")
        # Create a backup of the current package state
        backup_file="/tmp/package_state_backup_$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S).tar.gz"
        
        # Create the backup file
        tar -czf $backup_file /etc/apk/keys /etc/apk/repositories
        
        # Check if the backup file has non-zero size
        if [ -s $backup_file ]; then
            echo "$backup_file"
            
            # Return code: 0 on success
            exit 0
        else
            echo "Failed to create backup"
            exit 1
        fi
        ;;

    "restore")
        # Restore the system state from the most recent backup
        # Find the most recent backup file
        backup_file=$(ls -t /tmp/package_state_backup_*.tar.gz | head -n 1)
        
        # Check if a backup file exists
        if [ -z "$backup_file" ]; then
            echo "No backup file found"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        # Restore the backup
        tar -xzf $backup_file -C /
        
        # Return code: 0 on success
        exit 0
        ;;

    "compare")
        # Compare original and post-modification states of a package
        if [ "$#" -lt 2 ]; then
            echo "Please provide the package name to compare"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        package=$2
        
        # Check if both files exist
        original_file="${package}_integrity_check.txt"
        post_mod_file="${package}_integrity_check_post_mod.txt"
        
        if [ ! -f $original_file ] || [ ! -f $post_mod_file ]; then
            echo "One or both of the required files do not exist"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        # Compare the contents of the files
        if cmp -s $original_file $post_mod_file; then
            echo "The contents of the files are the same"
            exit 1
        else
            echo "$package"
            echo "The contents of the files are different"
            exit 0
        fi
        ;;

    *)
        usage
        ;;

esac

#!/bin/bash

# Check if connection.log exists
if [ ! -f "connection.log" ]; then
    exit 0
fi

# Create blocklist.txt if it doesn't exist
if [ ! -f "blocklist.txt" ]; then
touch blocklist.txt
fi

# Read blocklist into an array
mapfile -t BLOCKED_IPS < blocklist.txt

# Process connection.log
while read -r line; do
    # Extract timestamp and IP
    timestamp=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $1 " " $2}')
    ip=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $5}')

    # Check if IP is already blocked
    if [[ "${BLOCKED_IPS[@]}" =~ "$ip" ]]; then
        continue
    fi

    # Store IP and timestamp in a temporary file
    echo "$timestamp $ip" >> temp.log

done < connection.log

# Sort temp.log by timestamp
sort -k1,1 -k2,2n temp.log > sorted.log

# Process sorted.log to detect violations
prev_time=""
prev_ip=""
conn_count=0

while read -r line; do
    timestamp=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $1 " " $2}')
    ip=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $3}')

    # Convert timestamp to seconds since epoch
    epoch_time=$(date -d "$timestamp" +%s)

    # Check if IP has changed
    if [ "$ip" != "$prev_ip" ]; then
        prev_time="$epoch_time"
        prev_ip="$ip"
        conn_count=1
    else
        # Calculate time difference
        time_diff=$((epoch_time - prev_time))

        # If within 30 seconds, increment count
        if [ "$time_diff" -le 30 ]; then
            conn_count=$((conn_count + 1))
        else
            # Reset count for new window
            prev_time="$epoch_time"
            conn_count=1
        fi
    fi

    # Check for violation
    if [ "$conn_count" -ge 4 ]; then
        echo "$ip"
        echo "$ip" >> blocklist.txt
        conn_count=0
    fi

done < sorted.log

# Clean up
cat temp.log > sorted.log
cat sorted.log > connection.log
cat blocklist.txt > blocklist.txt.sorted
mv blocklist.txt.sorted blocklist.txt
rm temp.log sorted.log

echo '#!/bin/sh
# User Management Script for Alpine Linux

# Function to update the system package repository
update_system() {
    apk update
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "System updated successfully."
    else
        echo "Failed to update the system."
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Function to create a user
create_user() {
    username=$1
    
    # Check if the user already exists
    if id "$username" &>/dev/null; then
        echo "User $username already exists."
        return 0
    fi

    # Generate a random password
    password=$(openssl rand -base64 12)

    # Create the user
    useradd -m "$username"

    # Set the password for the user
    echo "$username:$password" | chpasswd

    # Store the credentials in user_credentials.txt
    echo "$username:$password" >> user_credentials.txt

    echo "User $username created successfully with password $password."
}

# Function to create a user with a group
create_user_with_group() {
    username=$1

    # Check if the user already exists
    if id "$username" &>/dev/null; then
        echo "User $username already exists."
        return 0
    fi

    # Check if the group already exists
    if getent group "$username" &>/dev/null; then
        echo "Group $username already exists."
        return 0
    fi

    # Generate a random password
    password=$(openssl rand -base64 12)

    # Create the group
    groupadd "$username"

    # Create the user with the group as the primary group
    useradd -m -g "$username" "$username"

    # Set the password for the user
    echo "$username:$password" | chpasswd

    # Store the credentials in user_credentials.txt
    echo "$username:$password" >> user_credentials.txt

    echo "User $username created successfully with password $password and group $username."
}

# Function to cleanup users and groups
cleanup_users() {
    # Read the user credentials from the file
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        username=$(echo $line | cut -d':' -f1)
        password=$(echo $line | cut -d':' -f2)

        # Remove the user and their home directory
        userdel -r "$username"

        # Remove the group
        groupdel "$username"
    done < user_credentials.txt

    # Remove the user_credentials.txt file
    rm -f user_credentials.txt

    echo "All users and groups have been removed."
}

# Main script logic
if [ "$1" = "update" ]; then
    update_system
elif [ "$1" = "create" ]; then
    if [ -z "$2" ]; then
        echo "Usage: $0 create <username>"
        exit 1
    fi
    create_user "$2"
elif [ "$1" = "create_with_group" ]; then
    if [ -z "$2" ]; then
        echo "Usage: $0 create_with_group <username>"
        exit 1
    fi
    create_user_with_group "$2"
elif [ "$1" = "cleanup" ]; then
    cleanup_users
else
    echo "Usage: $0 update | create <username> | create_with_group <username> | cleanup"
    exit 1
fi' > /workspace/solution.sh

    echo "Failed to create original_dns_records.txt"

    echo "Failed to create modified_dns_records.txt"

if [ -s original_dns_records.txt ] && [ -s modified_dns_records.txt ];

    echo "Files created successfully."

    echo "File creation failed."

#!/bin/sh
# Check if apk is available
if ! command -v apk &> /dev/null; then
echo "Error: apk package manager is not available." >&2
exit 1
fi

# Handle different commands
case $1 in
list)
# Create installed_packages.txt
if [ -f installed_packages.txt ]; then
rm installed_packages.txt
fi

# List all installed packages
apk info > installed_packages.txt
;;
backup)
# Create backup directory
if [ -d backup ]; then
rm -rf backup
fi
mkdir -p backup

# Copy /etc/apk to backup/etc/apk
if [ -d /etc/apk ]; then
cp -r /etc/apk backup/etc/apk
else
echo "Error: /etc/apk directory not found." >&2
exit 1
fi

# Copy /lib/apk/db to backup/lib/apk/db
if [ -d /lib/apk/db ]; then
cp -r /lib/apk/db backup/lib/apk/db
else
echo "Error: /lib/apk/db directory not found." >&2
exit 1
fi
;;
analyze)
if [ -z "$2" ]; then
echo "Error: Backup directory is required for analyze command." >&2
exit 1
fi

BACKUP_DIR=$2

# Check if backup directory exists
if [ ! -d $BACKUP_DIR ]; then
echo "Error: Backup directory $BACKUP_DIR does not exist." >&2
exit 1
fi

# Create backup_packages.txt
if [ -f backup_packages.txt ]; then
rm backup_packages.txt
fi

# List all packages from the backup
if [ -d $BACKUP_DIR/lib/apk/db ]; then
find $BACKUP_DIR/lib/apk/db -type f -name "*.apk" -exec apk info -v {} \; > backup_packages.txt
else
echo "Error: No packages found in backup directory." >&2
exit 1
fi
;;
cleanup)
# Remove temporary files
find . -type f $\( -name "*.tmp" -o -name "temp_*" $\) -delete
;;
*)
echo "Usage: $0 {list|backup|analyze <backup_dir>|cleanup}" >&2
exit 1
esac

exit 0

#!/bin/bash
# Check if curl or wget is available
curl --version > /dev/null 2>&1 || wget --version > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Error: Neither curl nor wget is available" >&2; exit 1; }

# Check if the correct number of arguments is provided
if [ "$#" -ne 2 ]; then
echo "Usage: $0 <operation_type> <package_name>"
exit 1
fi

operation_type=$1
package_name=$2

# Function to log messages
timestamp=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
log_message() {
  echo "$timestamp - $1" >> package_operations.log
}

# Check if the package is already installed
cmd="apt list --installed | grep $package_name"
$cmd > /dev/null 2>&1
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
  log_message "Package $package_name already installed"
  exit 0
fi

# Handle install operation
if [ "$operation_type" == "install" ]; then
  log_message "Installing $package_name..."
  
  # Use curl or wget to download the package
  if command -v curl > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    curl -O https://httpbin.org/get?package=$package_name
  else
    wget https://httpbin.org/get?package=$package_name
  fi

  # Check if the download was successful
  if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    log_message "Installing $package_name...successful"
  else
    log_message "Error: Failed to install $package_name"
  fi

# Handle update operation
elif [ "$operation_type" == "update" ]; then
  log_message "Updating $package_name to latest version"

  # Use curl or wget to update the package
  if command -v curl > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    curl -O https://httpbin.org/get?package=$package_name&version=latest
  else
    wget https://httpbin.org/get?package=$package_name&version=latest
  fi

  # Check if the update was successful
  if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    log_message "Updating $package_name to latest version...successful"
  else
    log_message "Error: Failed to update $package_name"
  fi

else
  log_message "Error: Invalid operation type $operation_type"
fi

    fi
}

# Install Git and Python 3
apt update && apt install -y git python3

#!/bin/bash

# Backup original resolv.conf
ORIGINAL_RESOLV_CONF=$(cat /etc/resolv.conf)

# Function to check if a command exists
command_exists() {
    command -v "$1" > /dev/null 2>&1
}

# Function to validate IPv4 address
validate_ip() {
    if [[ $1 =~ ^[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}$ ]]; then
        return 0
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

# Configure DNS server
configure() {
    if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
        echo "Usage: $0 configure <nameserver_ip>"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    local nameserver_ip="$1"
    
    if ! validate_ip "$nameserver_ip"; then
        echo "Invalid IPv4 address: $nameserver_ip"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Check if the nameserver is already configured
    if grep -q "nameserver $nameserver_ip" /etc/resolv.conf; then
        echo "Nameserver $nameserver_ip is already configured"
        exit 0
    fi
    
    # Backup original configuration
    echo "Original configuration backed up"
    
    # Add the new nameserver
    echo "nameserver $nameserver_ip" | sudo tee -a /etc/resolv.conf > /dev/null
    
    echo "DNS server $nameserver_ip configured"
}

# Query DNS
query() {
    if [ "$#" -lt 1 ]; then
        echo "Usage: $0 query <domain1> [domain2] [domain3] ..."
        exit 1
    fi
    
    local tools=("dig" "host" "nslookup")
    local tool_found=false
    
    for tool in "${tools[@]}"; do
        if command_exists "$tool"; then
            tool_found=true
            break
        fi
    done
    
    if ! $tool_found; then
        echo "No DNS query tool found (dig, host, or nslookup)"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    for domain in "$@"; do
        if ! $tool +short "$domain" 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "^[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}$"; then
            echo "$domain: No IP address found"
        else
            ip=$($tool +short "$domain" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
            echo "$domain: $ip"
        fi
    done
}

# Reset DNS configuration
reset() {
    if [ -z "$ORIGINAL_RESOLV_CONF" ]; then
        echo "No original configuration to restore"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Restore original configuration
    echo "Restoring original configuration"
    echo "$ORIGINAL_RESOLV_CONF" | sudo tee /etc/resolv.conf > /dev/null
    
    echo "DNS configuration restored"
}

# Main function
main() {
    if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "Usage: $0 configure <nameserver_ip> | query <domain1> [domain2] [domain3] ... | reset"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    case "$1" in
        configure)
            configure "$2"
            ;;
        query)
            query "${@:2}"
            ;;
        reset)
            reset
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Usage: $0 configure <nameserver_ip> | query <domain1> [domain2] [domain3] ... | reset"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
}

main "$@"

# Ensure rsync is installed
apk add rsync

# Verify and create directories if needed
if [ ! -d "/src" ]; then
  mkdir -p "/src"
  chmod 755 "/src"
fi

  mkdir -p "/dst"
  chmod 755 "/dst"

  src_file="/src/example.txt"
  dst_file="/dst/example.txt"

  # Check if example.txt exists in source
  if [ -f "$src_file" ]; then
    src_size=$(stat -c "%s" "$src_file")

    # Check if example.txt exists in destination
    if [ -f "$dst_file" ]; then
      dst_size=$(stat -c "%s" "$dst_file")

        echo "example.txt in /src is larger than 512KB. Preserving existing file in /dst."

    fi

  rsync -a --delete "$src_file" "$dst_file"

# Handle example.txt special case
handle_example_txt

# Check for errors
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "Error during synchronization."
  exit 1
fi

echo "Synchronization completed successfully."' > solution.sh
