#!/bin/bash

# Check if required tools are present
if ! command -v gcc &> /dev/null || ! command -v make &> /dev/null || ! command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
echo "Error: Required tools (gcc, make, curl) are not installed."
exit 1
fi

# Function to calculate factorial
factorial() {
    local n=$1
    local result=1

    for ((i=1; i<=n; i++)); do
        result=$((result * i))
    done

    echo $result
    return 0
}

# Function to fetch HTML webpage
http() {
    curl -o output.txt http://example.com

    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        if [ $(wc -c < output.txt) -ge 100 ]; then
            return 0
        else
            echo "Error: The response is less than 100 bytes."
            return 1
        fi
    else
        echo "Error: Failed to fetch the webpage."
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to cleanup files
cleanup() {
    find . -type f $\( -name "*.c" -o -name "*.o" -o -name "*.txt" $\) -exec rm -f {} +

    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        return 0
    else
        echo "Error: Failed to cleanup files."
        return 1
    fi
}

# Main script logic
if [ $# -lt 1 ]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <command> [arguments]"
    echo "Available commands: factorial, http, cleanup"
    exit 1
fi

command=$1

if [ "$command" = "factorial" ]; then
    if [ $# -ne 2 ]; then
        echo "Usage: $0 factorial <number>"
        exit 1
    fi

    n=$2

    if ! [[ $n =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
        echo "Error: The input must be a positive integer."
        exit 1
    fi

    factorial $n
elif [ "$command" = "http" ]; then
    http
elif [ "$command" = "cleanup" ]; then
    cleanup
else
    echo "Error: Unknown command: $command"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Check if required tools are present
if ! command -v gcc &> /dev/null || ! command -v make &> /dev/null || ! command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
echo "Error: Required tools (gcc, make, curl) are not installed."
exit 1
fi

# Function to calculate factorial
factorial() {
    local n=$1
    local result=1

    for ((i=1; i<=n; i++)); do
        result=$((result * i))
    done

    echo $result
    return 0
}

# Function to fetch HTML webpage
http() {
    curl -o output.txt http://example.com

    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        if [ $(wc -c < output.txt) -ge 100 ]; then
            return 0
        else
            echo "Error: The response is less than 100 bytes."
            return 1
        fi
    else
        echo "Error: Failed to fetch the webpage."
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to cleanup files
cleanup() {
    find . -type f $\( -name "*.c" -o -name "*.o" -o -name "*.txt" $\) -exec rm -f {} +

    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        return 0
    else
        echo "Error: Failed to cleanup files."
        return 1
    fi
}

# Main script logic
if [ $# -lt 1 ]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <command> [arguments]"
    echo "Available commands: factorial, http, cleanup"
    exit 1
fi

command=$1

if [ "$command" = "factorial" ]; then
    if [ $# -ne 2 ]; then
        echo "Usage: $0 factorial <number>"
        exit 1
    fi

    n=$2

    if ! [[ $n =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
        echo "Error: The input must be a positive integer."
        exit 1
    fi

    factorial $n
elif [ "$command" = "http" ]; then
    http
elif [ "$command" = "cleanup" ]; then
    cleanup
else
    echo "Error: Unknown command: $command"
    exit 1
fi

# Check if jq is installed, if not, install it
if ! command -v jq > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo 'jq is not installed. Installing now...'
  apk add jq
fi

# Check jq version
jq --version > /dev/null 2>&1
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
  echo 'jq is installed but not functioning properly.'
  exit 1
fi

# Check if commands.json exists, if not, create it
if [ ! -f commands.json ]; then
  echo '{}'> commands.json
fi

# Main logic
case $1 in
  download)
    # Create or update commands.json with some default data
    echo '{"commands":[{"name":"ls","options":["-l","-a","-h"]},{"name":"grep","options":["-r","-i","-v"]},{"name":"find","options":["-name","-type","-mtime"]}]}' > commands.json
    
    # Verify that the file was created and is valid JSON
    if [ ! -f commands.json ]; then
      echo 'Error: commands.json could not be created.'
      exit 1
    fi
    
    # Validate JSON structure
    jq '.' commands.json > /dev/null 2>&1
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
      echo 'Error: commands.json is not valid JSON.'
      exit 1
    fi
    ;;

  list)
    # Read command names and options from commands.json and format output
    jq -r '.commands[] | "\(.name): \(.options | length)"' commands.json
    ;;

  filter)
    if [ -z "$2" ]; then
      echo 'Error: Missing command name for filter action.'
      exit 1
    fi
    
    # Check if the command exists in commands.json
    command_exists=$(jq -r '.commands[] | select(.name == "'$2'") | .name' commands.json)
    if [ -z "$command_exists" ]; then
      echo 'Error: Command not found.'
      exit 1
    fi
    
    # Display the options for the specified command
    jq -r '.commands[] | select(.name == "'$2'") | .options[]' commands.json
    ;;

  *)
    echo 'Error: Invalid action.'
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

# Set appropriate file permissions
chmod 644 commands.json

#!/bin/bash

# Function to generate a random string
random_string() {
    cat /dev/urandom | tr -dc 'a-zA-Z0-9' | fold -w 10 | head -n 1
}

# Function to log the random string with timestamp
log_string() {
    local rand_str=$1
    local timestamp=$(date +%s)

    # Check if log file exists, create if not
    if [[ ! -f "string_log.txt" ]]; then
        touch string_log.txt
    fi

    # Check if log file has more than 10 entries
    if [[ $(wc -l < string_log.txt) -ge 10 ]]; then
        # Remove the oldest entry
        sed -i '1,1d' string_log.txt
    fi

    # Append the new entry
    echo "${timestamp}:${rand_str}" >> string_log.txt
}

# Main script logic
if [[ $# -ne 1 ]]; then
    exit 1
fi

mode=$1

case $mode in
    "single")
        # Clear any output
        > /dev/null
        ;;

    "three")
        # Output exactly two lines of text
        echo "Line 1"
        echo "Line 2"
        ;;

    "random")
        # Generate a random string
        rand_str=$(random_string)

        # Log the string with timestamp
        log_string $rand_str

        # Print confirmation message
        echo "Log cleared and updated with new random string: $rand_str"
        ;;

    *)
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

exit 0
